identity.alias_note: Identity via sleeper_projection_idmap.csv: sleeper_id -> player_key (status 'matched' or 'gsis_not_in_players'). player_key -> player_norm via fixture player_keys (reversed). Unresolvable identities are excluded, never guessed.

inputs.per_game_note: Per-game PPG = average of remaining-week RotoWire projections (via Sleeper; weeks 7-18 for 2026 season). pts_ppr / pts_half_ppr / pts_std columns used directly from weekly_projections_sleeper.csv.gz. Identity via sleeper_projection_idmap.csv (sleeper_id -> player_key).
inputs.pies_note: Positional pies measured from the current RotoWire data (tier surplus). No pies file: a static file goes stale when the player pool changes.
